name: cochlea-mcp
description: Render, analyze, and verify audio (WAV/FLAC) offline and deterministically, exposed as MCP tools.
long_description: Cochlea is a headless, deterministic audio engine. This server exposes it as MCP tools: render a declarative score to byte-identical PCM, extract loudness/pitch/tempo/key/structure reports from any WAV or FLAC, generate spectrograms, and diff two renders against each other. No ffmpeg, no audio device, no realtime path.

tools.name: render_score
tools.description: Render a cochlea RON score to a deterministic WAV mix, optionally running its embedded verify assertions.

tools.name: probe_audio
tools.description: Extract the full feature report (loudness, onsets, pitch, key, tempo, stereo, structure) from a WAV or FLAC file.

tools.name: spectrogram
tools.description: Render a mel spectrogram PNG, or a tiled contact sheet, from a WAV or FLAC file.

tools.name: lint_score
tools.description: Statically validate a RON score against the instrument/preset catalog without rendering audio.

tools.name: probe_digest
tools.description: A compact text digest of a WAV or FLAC file, sized for an LLM's context window.

tools.name: audio_diff
tools.description: Compare two audio files in feature space and report byte-identical, tier-2 equivalent, or different.
